description: Optional manually curated evidence. Each record must reference an existing stable effector_id and host_protein_id. Multiple evidence rows for a relationship are supported.

evidence.provenance: McGourty et al., Science 2012 (SifA binds SKIP/PLEKHM2)
evidence.note: Co-immunoprecipitation and functional assays show SifA forms a complex with SKIP/PLEKHM2 in infected cells.

evidence.provenance: McGourty et al., Science 2012 (S. Typhi SifA-SKIP/PLEKHM2)
evidence.note: Same published SifA-SKIP binding evidence applied to the S. Typhi effector row.

evidence.provenance: Meng et al., Cell 1996 (InlA is the E-cadherin ligand)
evidence.note: Affinity chromatography identified E-cadherin as the cellular receptor for Listeria internalin.

evidence.provenance: Shen et al., Cell 2000 (InlB binds/activates MET)
evidence.note: InlB binds the MET extracellular domain and is required for InlB-dependent entry.

evidence.provenance: Wilke & Bubeck Wardenburg, PNAS 2010 (Hla-ADAM10)
evidence.note: ADAM10 was purified as an Hla-binding protein and shown to be required for toxin binding.

evidence.provenance: Chung & Collier, Biochim Biophys Acta 1977 (diphtheria toxin ADP-ribosylates EF-2)
evidence.note: Kinetic analysis of EF-2 ADP-ribosylation catalyzed by diphtheria toxin fragment A.

evidence.provenance: Wu et al., PNAS 1998 (BFT cleaves E-cadherin)
evidence.note: Bacteroides fragilis enterotoxin specifically cleaves the extracellular domain of E-cadherin.

evidence.provenance: Yuan et al., Science Advances 2023 (SipA binds and stabilizes F-actin)
evidence.note: Cryo-EM shows SipA binds along F-actin grooves and stabilizes filaments through charged interface residues.

evidence.provenance: D'Costa et al., Cell Reports 2015 (SopD2 binds and inhibits Rab7)
evidence.note: SopD2 directly binds Rab7 and inhibits nucleotide exchange, limiting Rab7 effector recruitment.

evidence.provenance: Singh et al., JEM 2003 (M. tuberculosis LAM blocks Ca2+/hVPS34 signaling)
evidence.note: M. tuberculosis lipoarabinomannan blocks the Ca2+/calmodulin-PI3K hVPS34 cascade required for phagosome maturation.

evidence.provenance: Tran Van Nhieu et al., EMBO J 1999 (IpaC induces actin polymerization)
evidence.note: IpaC induced filopodial/lamellipodial extensions and actin polymerization in semi-permeabilized and microinjected cells.

evidence.provenance: Salcedo et al., PLoS Pathogens 2008 (Btp1/BtpA interferes with TLR2 signaling)
evidence.note: Experimental work shows Btp1/BtpA interferes with TLR2 signaling in dendritic cells; this is pathway-level evidence rather than direct receptor binding.

evidence.provenance: Latomanski et al., PLoS Pathogens 2016 (Cig57 hijacks FCHO-mediated clathrin trafficking)
evidence.note: Cig57 hijacks FCHO-dependent clathrin-mediated trafficking; this supports pathway subversion rather than a demonstrated direct Cig57-CLTC binding event.

evidence.provenance: Park et al., Infect Immun 2003 (Msp2/p44 facilitates granulocyte adherence)
evidence.note: Recombinant Msp2 binds PSGL-1-expressing cells and reduces PSGL-1 antibody binding; the study supports Msp2/PSGL-1 association without establishing Msp2 as the sole PSGL-1 adhesin.

evidence.provenance: Haglund et al., Nature Cell Biology 2010 (R. rickettsii Sca2 is a formin-like actin nucleator)
evidence.note: Sca2 nucleates unbranched actin filaments, associates processively with barbed ends, and uses profilin to drive actin-based motility.

evidence.provenance: Klee et al., Cellular Microbiology 2012 (R. conorii Sca2 actin-nucleating domains)
evidence.note: R. conorii Sca2 has separable mammalian-association and actin-nucleating domains that support intracellular actin-based motility.

evidence.provenance: Chung & Collier, Infect Immun 1977 (Pseudomonas exotoxin A ADP-ribosylates EF-2)
evidence.note: Pseudomonas aeruginosa exotoxin A catalyzes NAD-dependent ADP-ribosylation of mammalian elongation factor 2 in vitro and in vivo.

evidence.provenance: Zhou et al., BBRC 2006 (IbeA interacts with vimentin)
evidence.note: Vimentin was identified on brain microvascular endothelial cells as an IbeA-binding protein that mediates E. coli K1 binding and invasion.

evidence.provenance: Rytkönen et al., Infect Immun 2001 (gonococcal pilin binds CD46)
evidence.note: Soluble gonococcal pilin bound a CD46-sized band, and CD46 antibodies or soluble pilin blocked Neisseria gonorrhoeae binding to target cells and tissue.

evidence.provenance: Avadhanula et al., Infect Immun 2006 (NTHI P5 fimbriae bind ICAM-1)
evidence.note: Anti-P5 antiserum reduced NTHI adhesion to ICAM-1 cells and recombinant ICAM-1 bound P5-expressing but not P5-deficient outer membrane preparations.

evidence.provenance: Andersen-Nissen et al., PNAS 2005 (C. jejuni flagellin evades TLR5 recognition)
evidence.note: This study supports a C. jejuni flagellin-TLR5 interface through demonstrated TLR5 evasion/non-recognition rather than TLR5 activation.

evidence.provenance: Löwer et al., EMBO Reports 2010 (H. pylori HtrA cleaves E-cadherin)
evidence.note: H. pylori HtrA was shown to cleave E-cadherin and disrupt epithelial adherens junctions.

evidence.provenance: Spaan et al., Cell Host & Microbe 2013 (PVL targets C5a receptors)
evidence.note: LukS-PV binds the C5a receptor C5aR and the C5a-like receptor C5L2 on human myeloid cells.

evidence.provenance: Hammer et al., Infect Immun 2001 (PspA binds lactoferrin)
evidence.note: Pneumococcal surface protein A was shown to mediate binding of human lactoferrin to Streptococcus pneumoniae.

evidence.provenance: Duthy et al., Infect Immun 2002 (PspC binds factor H via SCR13-15)
evidence.note: Factor H binding was PspC dependent and mapped to factor H short consensus repeats 13 to 15.

evidence.provenance: Popoff et al., FEMS Microbiology Letters 2000 (C. difficile binary toxin ADP-ribosylates actin)
evidence.note: C. difficile binary toxin production was linked to an actin-specific ADP-ribosyltransferase activity.

evidence.provenance: Batah et al., Anaerobe 2016 (C. difficile FliC activates TLR5)
evidence.note: C. difficile FliC flagellin interacted with TLR5 and predominantly activated TLR5-linked NF-kB signaling in epithelial cell models.

evidence.provenance: Stevens et al., J Bacteriol 2011 (B. pseudomallei BimA binds/polymerizes actin)
evidence.note: BimA motifs required for intracellular motility, actin binding, and actin polymerization were experimentally identified.

evidence.provenance: Eicken et al., J Biol Chem 1999 (DbpA decorin binding residues)
evidence.note: Critical lysine residues in Borrelia burgdorferi DbpA required for decorin binding were identified by mutagenesis.

evidence.provenance: Bulut et al., J Immunol 2001 (OspA lipoprotein activates TLR2/TLR6)
evidence.note: OspA lipoprotein activated NF-kB through TLR2/TLR6 in transfected endothelial cells; this supports OspA-TLR2 engagement in a lipoprotein context.
